google_play_app_details.title: Example Meal Planner: Recipes
google_play_app_details.summary: Plan a week of meals in 5 minutes and get the shopping list made for you.
description_features: Plan a week of meals in 5 minutes
One shopping list for the week, sorted by store aisle
Diet filters: vegetarian, gluten-free and dairy-free
Pantry tracker suggests meals that use what you already have
Scale any recipe from 1 to 8 servings; the list updates by itself
Share your plan with a partner on their own phone
